Create a delegated identity under you

## Usage

```console
coder identities create [flags] [name]
```

## Description

```console
Creating an identity returns a record and no credential. The identity gets its credentials where it is used: in a workspace created on its behalf.
```

## Options

### --scope

| Property | Value                     |
|----------|---------------------------|
| Type     | <code>string-array</code> |

A scope the identity may use with the Coder API, as API tokens name them. Repeat for more. Without any, the identity can do nothing.

### --parent

| Property | Value               |
|----------|---------------------|

The delegated identity or user to create the identity under. It defaults to you.
